import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] f = new long[30];

    public static long solve(long n) {
        if (n <= 6) return n;
        long r1 = (long) 1e9, r2 = (long) 1e9;

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (f[i] > n) {
                r1 = solve(n % f[i - 1]) + i * (n / f[i - 1]);
                break;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (f[i] >= n) {
                if (f[i] - n >= n) r2 = (long) 1e9;
                else r2 = solve(f[i] - n) + (i + 1);
                break;
            }
        }
        return Math.min(r1, r2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++) {
            f[i] = f[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(solve(n));
        sc.close();
    }
}
